summary: community.docker deprecations: docker_compose (v1) will be removed in 4.0.0 (use docker_compose_v2), docker_container's image_name_mismatch default changes from ignore to recreate, and ssl_version options will be removed in 4.0.0.
questions: What should I use instead of the docker_compose module?
Will docker_container recreate containers when the image name changes?
Is the ssl_version option still needed in community.docker?

answer_card.title: community.docker deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- `docker_compose` (Compose v1) will be removed in 4.0.0. Migrate to `community.docker.docker_compose_v2`.
- `docker_container`: the `image_name_mismatch` default changes from `ignore` to `recreate` in 4.0.0. Set it explicitly to avoid surprises.
- `ssl_version` options will be removed in 4.0.0 (already gone from Docker SDK 7.0.0).
